acceptedItems.change: Add bounded static lint for required metadata, missing scripts/assets/references, case mismatches, broken internal links, portability and agent-specific configuration. Show content diffs for instructions, scripts and permission/tool declarations before update. Surface newly introduced network destinations or dependencies as review evidence, without declaring a skill safe based on a heuristic score. Offer opt-in isolated evaluations with representative prompts; never execute skill scripts as part of routine inventory. Reuse gh publish --dry-run for authoring validation where its repository discovery fits. gh publish --fix strips installation metadata: it is not a repair command for installed updates.
acceptedItems.acceptance: Valid format, agent-compatible, intact payload and reviewed source are separate states. Missing dependencies have concrete repair guidance. Evaluations require an explicit runnable environment and cannot silently incur agent/API execution. Preserve user-authored instructions unless a reviewed edit is selected.

acceptedItems.change: Offer one maintenance queue grouped by issue and physical install, with source, revision, owner, exposures, confidence and recommended action. Permit row→compare→plan→apply→verify. Mark unknown update state honestly and provide an explicit refresh. Add CLI inspect/check/plan/apply/repair/undo with exact IDs, versioned JSON schemas, meaningful skipped/partial/refused codes and a plan-file contract. Separate cleanup suppression, disablement, pinning and migration. Report disk-updated versus active-session state, and agent-specific reload/restart instructions.
acceptedItems.acceptance: A selected row always identifies exact affected paths. Every skip/partial result explains what happened. Current Claude plugin docs say running sessions retain loaded plugin versions after background updates; display that as a reload requirement, not failed filesystem verification. Runtime state is unknown unless observed.
